title: Yosemite Hiker on Rock, Mountain River Pool - Antique 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A man stands atop a smooth rock in the midst of a placid mountain pool, surrounded by massive granite boulders and dense pine woodland. In the distance, sheer rocky canyon slopes rise into the hazy sky, typical of the Sierra Nevada range and Yosemite Valley. He wears outdoor field attire—trousers, a buttoned collared shirt, and a wide-brimmed hat—embodying early twentieth-century American wilderness recreation, leisure, and the expanding popularity of visiting national parks during the 1920s.
